resolution: InstantMesh produced a clean textured blue_cat.obj (user confirmed, looks great) but the Studio importer was GLB-only. Added OBJ support: importMesh.ts objToTriangles + objToEditMesh (parse v/f, fan-triangulate n-gons, weld coincident verts, unwrap so it's paintable); the Studio ImportModelDialog now routes by extension (.obj via readFile text, .glb via readFileBase64), labels/title updated to GLB/OBJ, default-path finder includes .obj. Texture/MTL ignored by design (user paints fresh in Studio). Added an OBJ unit test; importMesh 6/6 pass, tsc-check clean. Committed. User: reload the dev host, click 'Import mesh', point at deps/InstantMesh/outputs/instant-mesh-large/meshes/blue_cat.obj. genmodel --backend instantmesh auto-pipe still pending.
